comparison.objective: Select the drilled hole that is deep enough and set an anchor bolt in it; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Hole-depth discrimination and anchor placement/setting versus mandrel alignment inside installed coils, regulated bimanual impact fracture, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Anchor set in the sufficiently deep hole versus four manufactured-notch fractures, four contained tangs, and undamaged retained inserts/shell. Setting method and numeric rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Possible shared striking or hole alignment is generic; installing an anchor has a different mechanical result from removing sacrificial tangs while preserving coils.
